title: IAM Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:&nbsp;</strong>Hybrid from Austin, TX</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong><strong><br></strong>The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is dedicated to ensuring the secure and efficient management of user identities, access privileges, and authentication mechanisms across internal systems, applications, and data. Our mission is to safeguard the organization against unauthorized access, protect sensitive information, and enable seamless user experiences while adhering to industry best practices and compliance standards.</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>As an Identity and Access Management (IAM) Security Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and scaling identity and access management solutions for Cloudflare’s internal workforce and workloads. You will be responsible for safeguarding our systems, applications, and data by ensuring secure user access, authentication, and authorization mechanisms.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, test, and deploy IAM solutions across authentication, authorization, and accounting&nbsp;</li> <li>Leverage Cloudflare products to secure our identities</li> <li>Build SSO integrations leveraging SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM</li> <li>Build and manage the Identity Governance and Administration platform</li> <li>Develop automated roles leveraging RBAC and ABAC</li> <li>Build and manage an access certification platform&nbsp;</li> <li>Build and manage a Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform</li> <li>Provide operational support of IAM systems including an on-call rotation that may include after hours calls</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <p>Security engineers take part in a wide variety of tasks and projects in the team. One individual is not expected to know everything, but a working knowledge in several of the following areas is required:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of identity federation (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, etc.)</li> <li>Experience implementing Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions including lifecycle management, SCIM, birthright access (RBAC, ABAC), and access certifications</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build production-grade automation scripts and tools. Must possess hands-on engineering experience leveraging AI/LLMs to solve operational or technical challenges.</li> <li>Experience with secure configuration of containerized application platforms (e.g. Kubernetes)</li> <li>Advanced scripting experience (Python, TypeScript, Bash, etc.)</li> <li>Experience implementing Zero Trust controls</li> <li>Experience integrating with applications and SaaS solutions&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with Identity and Access Management policy application and enforcement</li> <li>Experience working with Identity Threat Detection &amp; Response (ITDR)</li> <li>Experience working with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools like Terraform, Ansible, etc.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.&nbsp; More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. &nbsp;We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. &nbsp;All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. &nbsp;Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. &nbsp;If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: Headquarters: Remote, North America Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team In this role, you’ll join Stripe’s Vulnerability Management team, whose mission is to “Surface vulnerabilities at scale across Stripe.” Our vision is to create a culture of continuous excellence in managing vulnerabilities. The bug bounty program is an important pillar of this mission, acting as a critical line of defense in Stripe’s security “immune system.” What you’ll do We seek a highly technical and detail-oriented Security Analyst to join our team, focusing on the front lines of bug bounty triage and researcher engagement. In this role, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of security vulnerability reports from our bug bounty program. You’ll own the overall effectiveness of Stripe’s bug bounty program with autonomy to implement continuous improvements (e.g., researcher campaigns, scoring transparency). description: Headquarters: Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland W Base naszą misją jest wspieranie przedsiębiorców w podbijaniu globalnego e-commerce. Jesteśmy jedną z najszybciej rozwijających się platform w branży – w ciągu ostatnich 3 lat urośliśmy 15-krotnie! Dostarczamy system all-in-one dla tysięcy sprzedawców, integrując ich z Amazon, eBay czy Shopify. Ale technologia to nie wszystko. W tym zespole cenimy inżynierską rzetelność i ludzką przyzwoitość. Nie szukamy "Ninja" ani "Rockstara". Szukamy Partnera, któremu możemy zaufać. Zarządzanie infrastrukturą, która obsługuje miliony zapytań, to rola wysokiego zaufania. Dlatego szukamy osoby o mocnym kręgosłupie moralnym. Twój Stack Technologiczny Pracujemy na solidnym, wydajnym stacku. Musisz go znać od podszewki Core: Linux (Debian/Ubuntu), Nginx (głęboki tuning i optymalizacja), PHP-FPM Cloud: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, Lambda, IAM) Data: MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ Observability: Datadog, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) IaC: Terraform / Ansible Twoje zadania Będziesz zarządzać uprawnieniami do infrastruktury. Oczekujemy pedantycznej dbałości o to, kto i dlaczego ma dostęp do serwerów Wdrażanie koncepcji stabilnego działania usług w chmurze AWS, które wytrzymają nasz dynamiczny wzrost Utrzymanie serwerów Unix/Linux – konfiguracja, aktualizacje i automatyzacja, z pełnym zrozumieniem tego, co dzieje się w systemie operacyjnym Reagowanie na incydenty w oparciu o głęboką analizę logów (DD, Elastic). Szukanie przyczyn źródłowych (Root Cause Analysis), a nie tylko restartowanie usług Wspieranie zespołów programistów, aby zapewnić ciągłą i płynną pracę systemu  Czego oczekujemy? Min. 4 lata doświadczenia: W roli DevOps/SysAdmin, w tym praktyka z AWS Bardzo dobra znajomość chmury, ale popartej doświadczeniem w klasycznej administracji (mile widziana przeszłość w utrzymaniu serwerów fizycznych/Data Center) Swobody w Linuxie: Terminal to Twoje naturalne środowisko pracy Moralności i Odpowiedzialności: Podejście "Can Do" łączysz z odpowiedzialnością za powierzone "klucze do królestwa". Pokorny wobec technologii: Wiesz, że każdy popełnia błędy, ale Ty wiesz jak to naprawić Analizuje problem "360 stopni": Patrzysz na problem z każdej strony – bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i długofalowych skutków Łączy chmurę z "metalem": Pracujemy na AWS, ale szukamy kogoś, kto rozumie fizyczną naturę serwera Języka: Angielski min. B2 (pracujemy globalnie) Mile widziane Certyfikaty AWS (potwierdzające wiedzę) Praktyczna znajomość Terraform Znajomość Apache Kafka lub Cloudflare Chęć rozwoju w kierunku agentowego DevOps (automatyzacja procesów) Co oferujemy? Środowisko, w którym błędy traktujemy jak lekcje. CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 
 
CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 
 
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better.

CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 
 
CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 
 
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better.

raw_data.description:
about the role
 
you will be the hands‑on driver of our wallet and max (rent & education) growth initiatives. working closely with product, design, marketing, and rewards teams, you’ll take strategic briefs, execute end‑to‑end campaigns across all in‑app channels, and own a/b tests to optimize for business KPIs.

lists.content:
• campaign creation, execution and monitoring:
  • launch and optimize campaigns across in‑app banners, push notifications, email, and other owned channels, tied to business objectives.
  • devise innovative growth campaigns that have the potential to shift baselines on the metrics you own
  • track your charter’s / lob’s daily / weekly performance like a hawk and be on a continuous lookout of every incremental optimisation opportunity or any red flags that bubble up
  • a/b testing & optimization:
  • design, implement, and analyze a/b tests—from hypothesis through to rollout recommendations.
  • surface learnings and iterate quickly to drive continuous uplift.
  • truth seeking and user understanding:
  • dig deep into metrics, data, and user feedback to understand what is genuinely driving or stifling growth. you need to be committed to finding the truth, regardless of preconceptions or assumptions.
  • analytical rigor will be an essential part of your role as you analyze data to get insights, build hypotheses, identify opportunities and measure success of experiments conducted
  • use mixpanel (or equivalent) and basic dashboards / sql queries to track campaign performance and user behavior.
  • track your core kpis (e.g., activation rates, wallet loads, rent‑payment transactions, re‑engagement) with the help of analytics team
  • cross‑functional collaboration:
  • part of your mandate is to promote seamless integration of growth initiatives across all departments.
  • work closely with product, design, marketing, and engineering teams to align on creative assets, user journeys, incentive structures and work with teams on large campaigns
  • liaise with the business and product leads for campaign briefs, strategic priorities, and stakeholder updates.
  • process & documentation:
  • maintain clear play‑books and campaign templates.
  • document test plans, results, and key learnings.

• 1 year - 3 years in product management or growth roles
  • high energy, proven executional bias for action—comfortable owning the end‑to‑end “doer” work.
  • strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • good to have - able to navigate mixpanel (or similar) and write simple sql queries.
  • empathy for end consumers, with a focus on identifying and addressing their needs and pain points
  • strong attention to detail—ensuring error‑free campaign setup.
  • excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to diverse audiences
  • collaborative mindset and ability to juggle multiple stakeholders
  • comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and managing multiple competing priorities

raw_data.additional:
how is life at CRED? 
 
working at CRED would instantly make you realise one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role, you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee good company. 
 
hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realise pushing oneself is hard work. this is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate itself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and comprehensive health insurance. 
 
to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things,  CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.
 
there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!</p></div><p>At Figma, we're building a vibrant community where designers and product builders come together to learn, grow, and connect around their shared passion. Our Advocacy team is central to this mission—empowering our users through engaging content, meaningful interactions, and genuine advocacy.</p> <p>We're looking for a Designer Advocate to partner closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Product teams. You'll bring deep design expertise, strong product intuition, and a genuine love for the design community into our go-to-market strategies. You'll also champion our users' voices internally, ensuring their perspectives shape our product evolution.</p> <p>You'll be covering the DACH region, where our main languages are German and Polish. Being fluent in either/both of these languages is pretty much a plus!</p> <p>This is a full time, hybrid role based out of our Berlin hub.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do at Figma:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Empower users at scale: Collaborate closely with Sales and Customer Experience teams to help customers unlock the full potential of Figma across real product workflows</li> <li>Create compelling content: Develop written, visual, and video resources that reflect how modern teams actually design and build, from early exploration to production-ready systems</li> <li>Inspire community connections: Foster meaningful relationships within the Figma community, identify collaboration opportunities, and nurture user-driven initiatives</li> <li>Speak and engage at events: Regularly present at industry meetups, conferences, and community events, sharing practical insights from real-world design work</li> <li>Champion user voices: Stay attuned to community feedback, sentiment, and emerging design trends—advocating internally to inform product decisions and improvements</li> </ul> <h4><strong>We'd love to hear from you if you have:</strong></h4> <ul> <li data-section-id="1br4mdv" data-start="0" data-end="189">Deep, hands-on Figma expertise and an entrepreneurial drive, with experience embedding Figma in real product teams and taking ideas from early exploration to polished, impactful outcomes</li> <li data-section-id="1xjoe05" data-start="190" data-end="341">A thorough understanding of modern product design workflows, development environments, design systems, tokens, and AI-assisted design or prototyping</li> <li data-section-id="9k4oob" data-start="342" data-end="554">Strong technical design skills, including experience working alongside developers or building tools that support design systems, and an understanding of how design decisions translate into development at scale</li> <li data-section-id="hqbr01" data-start="555" data-end="702">Clear, compelling communication skills, with the confidence to explain complex workflows and systems, speak publicly, and engage large audiences</li> <li data-section-id="1tvouqt" data-start="703" data-end="835" data-is-last-node="">A passion for contributing to the design community and a willingness to travel up to 25% of the time to connect with it in person</li> </ul> <h4><strong>While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Fluency in German or Polish</li> </ul> <p>At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2022-10/EEOC_KnowYourRights_screen_reader_10_20.pdf">equal opportunity workplace</a> - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status<strong>, </strong>or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.</p> <p>We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to <a href="mailto:accommodations-ext@figma.com">accommodations-ext@figma.com</a>. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.&nbsp;</p> <p>Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Holding interviews in an accessible location</li> <li>Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing</li> <li>Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers</li> <li>Changing the mode or format of interviews&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.</p> <p>By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.figma.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.figma.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p><strong>Application limits:</strong> To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:</p> <ul> <li>Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.</li> <li>Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.</li> </ul> <p>Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available Locations: Austin</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the role</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our primary focus is attracting top talent and empowering them to excel. We are seeking a motivated and collaborative Senior Recruiter to support the growth of our Tech teams. We value solution-oriented self- starters who thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and are passionate about making a meaningful impact. Your role will involve partnering strategically with hiring managers to design and implement tailored recruitment strategies, ensuring the successful acquisition of exceptional candidates, primarily through active sourcing. You'll collaborate closely with our People Business Partners, Coordinators, and various business leaders to drive the growth and success of our Tech Teams.</span></p> <h4><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strategic Partnership:</strong> Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, offering guidance, market insights, and best practices to shape effective hiring strategies.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Full-Cycle Recruiting:</strong> Own the end-to-end recruitment process, from developing customized hiring plans with your stakeholders to sourcing, interviewing, and closing top talent.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Diversity &amp; Inclusion: </strong>Work closely with hiring teams to enhance the attraction and hiring of a diverse range of candidates, championing inclusive processes at every step.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Creative Sourcing: </strong>Utilize creative sourcing techniques, with a heavy emphasis on direct outreach via LinkedIn and other platforms, to identify and engage highly qualified candidates for our cybersecurity and network security sales teams.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Pipeline Management:</strong> Proactively manage and maintain a healthy candidate pipeline, ensuring data integrity in our ATS (Greenhouse) and providing regular, insightful updates to internal stakeholders.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Project Leadership:</strong> Collaborate with the wider recruiting team on key initiatives and hiring projects, contributing to the continuous improvement of our talent acquisition function.</span></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A minimum of 5 years of end-to-end recruiting experience, ideally within a high-growth tech or SaaS company.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Direct experience hiring for Tech roles, with a strong preference for experience in the network security or cybersecurity sales domain.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Proven expertise in active sourcing and candidate engagement using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Demonstrated experience driving diversity and inclusion initiatives within the recruiting process and helping to build diverse, high-performing teams.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong influencing skills and a solution-oriented, results-driven mindset. The ability to be proactive and resourceful, identifying and addressing potential hiring bottlenecks before they arise.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Excellent organizational skills and a keen eye for detail.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A highly collaborative nature and the ability to thrive in a team-based environment.</span></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Compensation</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;" data-sheets-root="1">For Austin based hires: Estimated annual salary of $102,000 - $160,000</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Equity</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Benefits</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.&nbsp; Welfare Benefits</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Medical/Rx Insurance</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Dental Insurance</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Vision Insurance</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Flexible Spending Accounts</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Commuter Spending Accounts</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Fertility &amp; Family Forming Benefits</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Global Travel Medical Insurance</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Life &amp; Accident Insurance</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Employee Stock Participation Plan</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Time Off</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.&nbsp; More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. &nbsp;We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. &nbsp;All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. &nbsp;Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. &nbsp;If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p><p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p><p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p><p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. title: Manager, Global Entity Management
description: <h1><strong>About the role</strong></h1> <p>Datadog employs roughly 8,100 people across 35 countries through global subsidiaries, all under a Nevada parent. Some are operating companies. Others came to us through acquisitions. We open in new markets often enough that the structure is always moving, and we manage it in Diligent Entities. This role owns it.</p> <p>The work is entity formation and maintenance in many jurisdictions, corporate records and statutory filings, and daily coordination with the Finance, Tax and People teams. You will deal directly with government agencies, registries, registered agents and local counsel around the world. You will also be the person the rest of the company asks whenever a question touches our corporate structure.</p> <p>The role sits in Legal Operations, and you will report to our Senior Director, Legal Operations, who has supported entity management operations in the past. Our Associate General Counsel, Corporate &amp; Securities owns the work product and sets the standards for entity management and for our securities filings. Legal Operations runs the function; Corporate &amp; Securities owns the substance.</p> <p>The placement also gives you breadth. Legal Operations covers legal technology and systems, process design, outside counsel and spend operations, restricted party and sanctions screening, product legal support, and the department's AI work. We expect to cross-train you across those areas over time, and to cross-train colleagues into entity work. Entity management will remain the substantial majority of this job.</p> <p>On AI in particular, Legal Operations is where most of that work happens for the legal department. We look at how our current tools could be used better, we assess new ones, and we look for ways to extend AI into systems that were never built with it in mind. If you look at a manual process and wonder whether software should be doing it, there is room here for that.</p> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>On the securities side of the role</strong></p> <p>You will also handle Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4 and 5), Forms 144 and Rule 10b5-1 plan administration, supervised by our Associate General Counsel, Corporate &amp; Securities, who trains the team on it. Prior public company reporting experience is welcome but not required. We have trained people into this work before and it went well. What we need is someone who wants to learn it and who will hold the deadlines once trained.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1><strong>What you will do</strong></h1> <h2><strong>Global entity management: the core of the role</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Entity lifecycle. </strong>Manage formations, foreign qualifications, branch registrations, conversions, mergers, dissolutions, liquidations and deregistrations for our US and international entities, working with outside service providers and local counsel in each jurisdiction.</li> <li><strong>Good standing. </strong>Keep every entity in good standing wherever it operates. That covers annual reports and returns, statutory filings and business licenses. It also covers records for registered agents and agents for service of process, and the local compliance requirements that differ by country.</li> <li><strong>Government agencies and registries. </strong>Deal directly with company registries, tax authorities, chambers of commerce and other government bodies on filings, registrations, certificates and inquiries, some of which need regular follow-up.</li> <li><strong>Compliance calendar. </strong>Own the global entity compliance calendar. Know what is due, where and when, and flag it early rather than relying on a service provider's reminder.</li> <li><strong>Directors, officers and authority. </strong>Track director and officer appointments and resignations, maintain signature and delegation of authority records, and prepare powers of attorney, incumbency certificates and secretary's certificates. Keep internal systems current and make sure the people who need to know about a change in signing authority are told.</li> <li><strong>Portfolio rationalization. </strong>Review the legacy and dormant entities we hold, including those that came in through acquisitions. Form a view on which should be maintained, consolidated or wound down, then carry out the plan.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Corporate records and governance</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Corporate records. </strong>Maintain minute books, statutory registers, organizational charts and entity records worldwide, in physical and electronic form, so the portfolio stays audit-ready.</li> <li><strong>Governance documents. </strong>Draft board and stockholder resolutions, written consents, minutes for subsidiary matters, and organizational documents such as articles, bylaws and operating agreements, in support of routine governance matters and corporate transactions, for attorney review.</li> <li><strong>Document requests. </strong>Turn around internal and external requests for certificates of good standing, certified copies, apostilles and legalizations. These usually block something, so speed matters.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>KYC and due diligence support</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Incoming requests. </strong>Respond to and manage Know Your Customer (KYC), Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) and related diligence requests from banks, financial partners, customers and other stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Supporting documentation. </strong>Compile and maintain the entity ownership, formation and governance documentation those requests rely on.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working with Finance, Tax and People</strong></h2> <p>Entity decisions are rarely made by Legal alone, so a large share of this role is coordination.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Tax. </strong>Support tax-driven entity changes, restructurings and intercompany arrangements, and provide the corporate approvals, resolutions and records they require.</li> <li><strong>Finance and Treasury. </strong>Support statutory audits, bank account openings and closures, and signatory changes. Supply the entity data behind financial reporting and audit requests.</li> <li><strong>People. </strong>Work with the People team when we open in a new country. That covers employer registrations, local entity setup and the corporate steps that have to happen before anyone can be hired or paid.</li> <li><strong>Across the company. </strong>Be the reliable answer when Procurement, Sales, Real Estate or anyone else needs to know which entity to use, or how Datadog is structured.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Systems, data and process</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Diligent Entities. </strong>Own Diligent Entities as our system of record, covering data integrity, configuration and reporting. You will be the internal expert who trains others on it.</li> <li><strong>Data quality. </strong>Run periodic audits of entity records, fix records where the data has drifted, and get the register to a point where it can be trusted without a manual check.</li> <li><strong>Process. </strong>Build and maintain the trackers, workflows and standard operating procedures the function runs on, and document them well enough that someone else can pick them up.</li> <li><strong>Automation and AI. </strong>Work with the wider Legal Operations team to automate the repetitive parts of entity work, and help assess where AI tools earn their place, both here and elsewhere in the department. Entity management is full of high-volume, rules-based work, which makes it a good place to test them. No prior AI experience is needed. Curiosity and judgment about where AI does and does not belong matter more.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Securities support</strong></h2> <p><em>Supporting work, learnable on the job, performed for and supervised by our Associate General Counsel, Corporate &amp; Securities.</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Section 16. </strong>Prepare, file and track Forms 3, 4 and 5 for our Section 16 officers and directors, and maintain the supporting ownership records.</li> <li><strong>Forms 144 and 10b5-1. </strong>Prepare and file Forms 144 and administer the mechanics of Rule 10b5-1 plan adoptions, modifications and terminations.</li> <li><strong>Entity data for reporting. </strong>Supply the entity information behind our periodic SEC filings, including the subsidiary list filed with the Form 10-K.</li> <li><strong>Board support. </strong>Support board and committee matters as needed. Board and committee administration sits with our Corporate &amp; Securities group.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your team and the wider function</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Your direct report. </strong>Manage, develop and set priorities for one Corporate Paralegal, and bring them along on the entity work as you standardize it.</li> <li><strong>Shared services. </strong>Legal Operations runs as a shared services team. You will be cross-trained across other Legal Operations workstreams, and colleagues will be cross-trained into entity work, so the team can cover for each other and hold consistent standards.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Who you are</strong></h1> <h2><strong>What we need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Seven or more years of hands-on entity management experience, with substantial time on a multi-jurisdictional portfolio, whether in-house at a multinational, at a law firm or at a corporate services provider.</li> <li>Practical experience with entity formation and ongoing maintenance in multiple countries, including foreign qualification, good standing, annual filings, registered agents and local statutory requirements.</li> <li>Direct experience dealing with government agencies, company registries and regulators on corporate filings. You have chased a registry, fixed a rejected filing, and learned how long these things take.</li> <li>A track record of working with internal partners outside Legal, such as Finance, Tax and People, where the work only lands if the coordination is good.</li> <li>Proficiency with an entity management platform. We use Diligent Entities. If you have used a comparable system and will become an expert in ours, that works too.</li> <li>Strong document and spreadsheet skills. Legal and Finance work in Word and Excel, and Excel in particular carries a lot of the tracking and reporting in this role. The rest of the company runs on Google Workspace, so you will use both.</li> <li>Drafting skills for corporate governance documents such as resolutions, consents, certificates and minutes.</li> <li>Comfort with the local mechanics of an international portfolio, such as nominee and minority shareholder arrangements, local director requirements and statutory filings that vary by jurisdiction.</li> <li>Organization and attention to detail, and the capacity to hold a high volume of deadlines at once.</li> <li>Judgment about what you handle, what you flag and what you escalate, and the confidence to escalate early.</li> <li>Experience managing or mentoring a junior colleague.</li> <li>Willingness to learn the securities reporting side of the role and to hold those deadlines once trained.</li> <li>Willingness to be cross-trained more broadly across Legal Operations.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with outside counsel, registered agents and service providers in many countries and time zones.</li> <li>A bachelor's degree, an associate degree or a paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program. If you have none of these, we will consider equivalent relevant experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Exposure to Section 16, Forms 144, Rule 10b5-1 administration or public company reporting.</li> <li>Implementing or migrating an entity management system, or materially improving the data quality of an existing one.</li> <li>Rationalizing a legacy entity portfolio by consolidating or winding down dormant companies, including entities acquired through M&amp;A.</li> <li>Evaluating, piloting or rolling out legal technology or AI tools.</li> <li>Supporting restricted party or sanctions screening.</li> <li>Work at a multinational technology or SaaS company, or supporting one from a firm or service provider.</li> <li>A notary public commission in New York, or willingness to obtain one.</li> <li>Certification from NALA, the National Association of Legal Assistants (Certified Paralegal or Advanced Certified Paralegal), or from NFPA, the National Federation of Paralegal Associations (CORE Registered Paralegal or PACE Registered Paralegal).</li> </ul> <p><em>If you are strong on the entity management core and lighter on some of the rest of the two lists above, we would still like to hear from you. We are hiring for depth in the part of this role that is hardest to teach.</em></p> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. title: Strategic Partnerships Lead / Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:&nbsp;</strong>Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The web is undergoing a structural transition from a search-first economy to an AI-mediated, agentic ecosystem. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the world's web traffic, providing an unmatched, front-row view of how Large Language Models (LLMs), AI bots, and autonomous agents interact with digital content.</p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Strategic Partnerships Lead / Director</strong> to join Cloudflare’s Strategic Partnerships team. In this high-impact, zero-to-one role, you will define and execute our strategy to transform Cloudflare’s rich network and CDN data into actionable business, marketing, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) intelligence.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <p>You will act as the crucial bridge between enterprise customers, Product &amp; Engineering, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams. Your mission is to build and commercialize the "Analytics of the Agentic Era"—helping non-technical business leaders, CMOs, and digital publishers measure content value, track agentic traffic, and optimize brand visibility across AI answer engines.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>1. Product Influence &amp; Analytics Suite Definition</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to translate raw CDN, bot, and network traffic signals into executive-ready dashboards and commercial analytics products.</li> <li>Help design first-party analytics tools tailored for business personas—focusing on metrics like scraping-to-referral ratios, prompt library integrations, LLM brand presence, and content gap analysis.</li> <li>Run design partner programs with top enterprise customers and media brands to gather feedback, validate feature roadmaps, and co-develop analytics prototypes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. GTM Strategy &amp; Sales Enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Enterprise Sales and GTM teams to package, price, and position the Advanced Analytics Suite for commercial buyers.</li> <li>Create sales playbooks, value frameworks, and pitch materials that translate complex technical infrastructure data into compelling business stories for non-technical buyers.</li> <li>Serve as a domain expert in high-stakes customer meetings, executive briefing centers (EBCs), and pilot programs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Expanding the Buyer Horizon Beyond CISOs</strong></p> <ul> <li>Champion Cloudflare’s strategic positioning beyond security (CISOs) and infrastructure (CTOs), actively expanding our mindshare among CMOs, digital strategists, and commercial leaders.</li> <li>Educate external stakeholders on critical concepts in the agentic web, such as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and synthetic web traffic attribution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4. Ecosystem &amp; Strategic Alliances</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify, evaluate, and structure strategic partnerships with adjacent players in the marketing tech and AI ecosystem (e.g., AEO measurement platforms, attribution providers, AI ad networks, and commercial data platforms).</li> <li>Leverage ecosystem relationships to enrich Cloudflare’s analytics capabilities and build joint go-to-market motions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>10+ Years of Experience:</strong> Demonstrated track record in strategic partnerships, business development, product marketing, or strategy within digital media, martech, web analytics, or data platform ecosystems.</li> <li><strong>Technical + Commercial Fluency:</strong> Exceptional ability to understand complex technical infrastructure (CDNs, bot management, traffic logs, APIs) while possessing a keen empathy for marketing and business mechanics (KPIs, CAC/LTV, attribution, content monetization).</li> <li><strong>0-to-1 Builder Mindset:</strong> Proven experience taking early-stage, ambiguous product concepts from ideation to scaled commercial distribution.</li> <li><strong>C-Suite Storytelling &amp; Communication:</strong> Superior written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting to C-level executives (CMOs, CEOs) and simplifying complex developer concepts into strategic business imperatives.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong> Strong experience orchestrating alignment across engineering, product management, sales, legal, and executive leadership teams.</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Based in or willing to work hybrid from our <strong>San Francisco, CA</strong> or <strong>New York, NY</strong> or <strong>Austin, TX </strong>offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $195,000 - $268,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $186,000 - $255,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.&nbsp; Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!&nbsp; The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health &amp; Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility &amp; Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life &amp; Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.&nbsp; More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. &nbsp;We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. &nbsp;All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. &nbsp;Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. &nbsp;If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Engineering Manager, Data Center Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Hiring Locations: <strong>Atlanta, GA, Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p> <p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p> <p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>Team Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Site Delivery</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Production Operations</p> <ul> <li> <p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Documentation and DCIM</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p> </li> <li> <p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Security and Compliance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p> <ul> <li> <p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Business Reporting</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p> <p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p> <p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p> <p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and availability reporting to leadership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to travel regularly to data center sites.
