title: Clari + Salesloft: Senior Director, Product & Strategy
normalized_title: Clari + Salesloft: Senior Director, Product & Strategy
description: Headquarters: REMOTE - US Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System , enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY The Senior Director of Product Strategy & Operations is the analytical engine and operational heart of the Product organization. Reporting to the CPO, you will be responsible for transforming qualitative customer signals and quantitative product telemetry into the commercial strategies that drive our growth. You will lead a dedicated team to ensure that our product-led initiatives are not just visionary, but executed with precision across every department in the company. Key Responsibilities  Strategy & Financial Intelligence  Business Case & Financial Modeling: Own the economic engine of the product org. Build rigorous financial models and business cases to justify new investments, market entries, and portfolio pivots. ROI Evaluation: Establish a framework for measuring the return on R&D investment. Continuously audit product performance against projected commercial outcomes to inform resource reallocation. Product Health & OKRs: Architect and manage the global Product Scorecard. Define "North Star" metrics and ensure all team OKRs are mathematically linked to top-line company growth. Operational Leadership & Execution Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the primary connective tissue between Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance. Align disparate departments to ensure product-led initiatives are supported company-wide. New Product Introduction (NPI): Lead the cross-functional "Go-to-Product" engine. Own the operational readiness, field enablement, and launch synchronization for all major releases. Product Processes & Tooling: Design and scale the "Product Operating System." Optimize the end-to-end lifecycle—from discovery to sunset—and manage the integrated tech stack (e.g., Pendo, Productboard, Jira) to drive velocity. The Ideal Profile The Analytical Expert: You likely have a background in Management Consulting, Finance, or a highly analytical Product role. You can navigate a SQL database or a complex financial model as easily as a product roadmap. The Insight Translator: You have a rare ability to take "noisy" data and extract a clear, compelling narrative that convinces skeptical executives to change course. The Scale Leader: You have experience leading teams in high-growth environments ($100M+ ARR) and have a proven track record of implementing systems that survived a 2x or 3x increase in headcount. The AI/Tooling Visionary: You understand how to leverage the modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt, Pendo, etc.) and AI-driven sentiment analysis to automate the "boring" parts of reporting, allowing your team to focus on high-value strategy. At Clari + Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us! #LI-Remote Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from an @ clari.com  or @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Clari + Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page . We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration. It is Clari + Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.  The goal of Clari + Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.   Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.  Base Pay Range $197,000 — $281,000 USD To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clari-salesloft-senior-director-product-strategy

description: what is CRED? CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better. You’ll play a pivotal role in leading CRED's partner ecosystem across products, becoming the face of CRED to some of India’s top consumer brands. You will lead high-stakes partnerships, drive product adoption, and enable new growth through strategic merchant alliances. As a core part of the merchant-led growth (mlg) strategy, you’ll shape how millions engage with CRED.

title: YouTube Specialist - Trader channel
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About PhonePe Limited:</strong></p> <p>Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance,&nbsp;Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India,&nbsp;which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to&nbsp;accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Culture:</strong></p> <p>At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right&nbsp; thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of&nbsp; the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!</p> <p><video controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> <source src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mkZstuTlMFTM8sDh1x4NYm7WSLueqklb/view?resourcekey"></video></p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About The Role&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You are the algorithmic brain behind our highest-velocity financial property. This channel caters to active, serious investors focused on Futures and Options (F&amp;O), technical analysis, and market momentum. Your job is to decode the trading community’s unique psychology and use platform data to scale our viewership. You understand open interest, option chains, chart literacy, and the analytical mindset required to navigate the markets. Operating in our AI-first factory, you will use data models and automated scraping to spot macro trends and derivative catalysts before they hit the retail feed.</p> <p>Focus Area 1: Derivative Market Trend Hunting &amp; Catalyst Capture&nbsp;</p> <p>You don't wait for traditional planning cycles. You move at the speed of the market ticker.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You monitor live market catalysts, open interest shifts, option chain data, and technical setups to identify breaking content opportunities within minutes.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You translate complex technical analysis, derivative strategies, or macro announcements into high-impact, immediate concepts for our scriptwriters.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You run AI-powered social listening tools across financial platforms, specialized forums, and trading communities to catch retail sentiment shifts before they explode on YouTube.</p> </li> </ul> <p>You coordinate with the production team for rapid-response videos, ensuring we publish while market volume and volatility are still peaking.</p> <p>Focus Area 2: F&amp;O Psychology &amp; Advanced Retention Mechanics&nbsp;</p> <p>You know exactly what makes a serious, active market participant click and watch.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You optimize for the specific psychological triggers of the derivative community: risk management, position sizing, leverage, volatility, and the search for a definitive edge.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You design hook structures that establish immediate analytical authority, keeping viewers locked in through complex technical setups without losing pacing.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You build a distinct packaging strategy for active trading content: utilizing clean chart patterns, clear data overlays, and high-intent thumbnail concepts that command attention on a crowded screen.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You guide the editing team on the pacing of technical breakdowns, ensuring that option strategies and chart analysis are snappy, visually engaging, and highly scannable.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Focus Area 3: Algorithmic Agility &amp; Real-Time Channel Management&nbsp;</p> <p>You manage the channel like an active portfolio.</p> <ul> <li> <p>You monitor immediate velocity metrics: tracking click-through rates (CTR) and view-count acceleration within the critical first two hours of an upload.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You leverage YouTube Community posts, polls, and live alerts to keep the audience highly engaged around expiry days, market openings, and critical economic data releases.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You optimize live stream metrics, managing real-time engagement, interactive charts, and viewer retention during high-impact market hours.<br><br></p> </li> <li> <p>You collaborate with the Creative Project Manager to dynamically pivot the content backlog based on daily market performance and viewer drop-off zones.<br><br></p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></p> <p>Deep Derivative Literacy: You possess a strong understanding of F&amp;O mechanics, trading psychology, and technical analysis. You know how to read market depth, price action, and option Greeks.</p> <p>Data and Analytics Fluency: You can read a charting screen and a spreadsheet of audience analytics with equal comfort. You know how to extract actionable video concepts from raw platform metrics.</p> <p>Platform Mastery: 3 to 5 years of experience scaling hyper-engaged YouTube channels, specifically within the finance, equity markets, or active trading niches.</p> <p>Speed with High Precision: You thrive in high-pressure environments where getting an accurate, high-quality analysis out in two hours beats getting a perfect video out tomorrow.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Mindset to Succeed</strong></p> <p>Market-Driven: You love the energy of active markets. You see a sudden market correction or an expiry day surge as a high-value content opportunity.</p> <p>Audience-Centric: You understand the active trader's risk tolerance and pain points. You know exactly how to structure titles and thumbnails that address their market concerns or validate their strategies.</p> <p>Data-Obsessed: You do not guess what content works. You let the retention graphs, traffic sources, and performance data dictate the channel's next tactical move.</p> <p>Automation-First: You embrace the automated factory. You are excited to use AI tools to scrape market indicators, generate title variations, and analyze competitor packaging instantly.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Insurance Benefits - </strong>Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance</li> <li><strong>Wellness Program -</strong> Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System</li> <li><strong>Parental Support - </strong>Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program</li> <li><strong>Mobility Benefits - </strong>Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy</li> <li><strong>Retirement Benefits - </strong>Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Other Benefits - </strong>Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity,&nbsp; ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of&nbsp; gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. This position serves as key strategic compliance partner for human resources on employment and labour compliance requirements.<br><br>About the role<br>1. Areas of scope include all company hiring practices, wages, discrimination/harassment,&nbsp;workplace violence, accessibility and other employment obligations. Monitor the&nbsp;implementation of employment compliance programs, systems and training.<br>3. Initiates cross-functional efforts to drive organizational alignment and ensure compliance&nbsp;with employment obligations.<br>4. Defines success metrics for areas of responsibility and integrates them into core business&nbsp;metrics. Monitor, evaluate and measure operational program processes for review with&nbsp;cross-functional teams to close employment compliance gaps, and drive continuous&nbsp;improvement.<br>5. Articulates corporate positions on compliance matters to regulators and external agencies&nbsp;and directs involvement with regulators to ensure compliance with all legal requirements.<br>6. Today we have made significant progress on this vision by making digital payments far simpler and ubiquitous than it has ever been. However we wish to make it so easy, safe, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. And not just in Urban India. At PhonePe, our aim to transform the entire Indian landscape so that every Indian, in every corner of the country, makes significant economic progress. Onwards and upwards! That is our goal.</p> <p><strong>Why PhonePe Design:</strong></p> <p>If you are sold on the vision of the company, you may want to consider the design team as a place to make this a reality. The design team at PhonePe is a bunch of creative trailblazers who are leading the effort to make a dent in the fintech universe. Prototype to find the answer rather than arguing about it in a doc.</li> <li><strong>Make complex things simple.</strong> Turn dense financial data and regulated flows into something a first-time investor trusts and a serious trader respects. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Through strategic field campaigns, high-impact hosted events, and scalable operational frameworks, we drive awareness, generate enterprise pipeline, and support our company's rapid growth. As an intern on this team, you will not just support events execution—you will gain hands-on experience working inside a cutting-edge, AI-driven automation ecosystem designed to scale marketing footprint with maximum efficiency.</p> <p>As a Marketing Events &amp; Campaigns Intern, you will play a crucial supporting role in both the tactical execution of Cloudflare’s international field initiatives and the rolling rollout of our modern platform tools. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience across a variety of enterprise marketing formats, including intimate executive roundtables, deep-dive technical workshops, and flagship regional roadshows.</p> <p>You will contribute to the end-to-end event lifecycle, from logistical coordination and asset management to supporting our automated platform pipelines. Your work will directly insulate field &amp; event managers from operational drag, help maintain data hygiene across our data layers, and ensure our sales teams are fully enabled to accelerate pipeline conversion.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Unified Ecosystem Support:</strong> Assist with managing and testing entries within the <strong>OneSource Core Hub</strong> and tracking incoming sales-led requests.</li> <li><strong>Logistical Coordination:</strong> Help drive the logistical planning and execution of virtual events and in-person field activations across regions, including scheduling, vendor outreach, swag orders and asset preparation for events.</li> <li><strong>Social Media Content &amp; Management:</strong> Draft, create, and schedule engaging social media posts (primarily for LinkedIn) to promote upcoming hosted events, amplify regional customer panels, and share post-event highlights. Optimization:</strong> Support the team in testing, refining, and documenting our emerging AI platform features. This includes assisting with user-acceptance testing (UAT) for conversational AI triggers within the <strong>Marketing Concierge (Jojo)</strong> , auditing data outputs from our <strong>AI Registration Auditor skill</strong> , and compiling approved messaging libraries to optimize our automated AI executive copywriting and ghostwriting templates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous academic or professional experience with event coordination, digital campaign tracking, or project management.</li> <li>Basic understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce), marketing automation software (Marketo), or relational data management.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="5">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated monthly pay range is between €1,500 - €2,000.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.&nbsp; More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. &nbsp;We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. &nbsp;All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. &nbsp;Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. &nbsp;If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

eagerness to understand the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.</li> <li value="1">Practical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.</li> <li value="1">Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li value="1">Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields</li> <li value="1">German OR French language fluency - desirable</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We, the Solutions Architect team, are part of GitLab's Sales organization and serve as the technical counterpart to Account Executives, with this role Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h3> <p>As a Backend Engineer on the Chat Engine team, you'll build the engine behind GitLab Duo Chat, the conversational AI experience for GitLab. You'll work primarily in Python to build and maintain our agentic runtime: the Flow Registry, LangGraph flows, and the Duo Workflow Service. You'll also work in the GitLab Rails monolith, where Chat connects with the product.</p> <p>You'll own scoped parts of the system, ship small features and improvements with minimal guidance, and collaborate with the team on larger projects. You'll work alongside senior and staff engineers who will partner with you on design and support your growth.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Develop secure, well-tested, and performant features and improvements for GitLab Duo Chat.</li> <li>Implement and extend agentic flows in Python using LangGraph, registered through the Flow Registry and served by the Duo Workflow Service.</li> <li>Integrate Chat capabilities with the GitLab Rails monolith, including its GraphQL application programming interface (API).</li> <li>Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards for a high-scale environment, including tests with every merge request.</li> <li>Review code within our Code Review Guidelines and respond promptly to contributions from people who don't work for GitLab.</li> <li>Identify technical debt and propose and implement solutions that improve the team's efficiency.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Management, User Experience, and Frontend team members to improve product quality, security, and performance.</li> <li>Participate in Tier 2 or Tier 3 weekday, weekend, and occasional night on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="line-height: 1;">Professional experience with Python, including building and testing production services.</li> <li>Working proficiency with Ruby on Rails, or a willingness to learn it, since a meaningful part of Chat lives in the GitLab monolith.</li> <li>Exposure to, or strong interest in, building on top of large language models, including prompting, tool or function calling, evaluation, and the failure modes of non-deterministic systems.</li> <li>Experience designing and building APIs, including diagnosing and optimizing performance issues, and comfort working with well-documented third-party services.</li> <li>A security-minded development approach that applies secure coding guidelines early in the development process.</li> <li>Clear and concise written communication about technical problems and iterative solutions, which is essential in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Manage work independently, organize priorities, and ask for help when an issue is taking longer than expected.</li> <li>Demonstrate GitLab's values by collaborating effectively in a fully remote, intensely iterative environment.</li> <li>Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or a comparable agent orchestration framework.</li> <li>Experience with GraphQL and RSpec.</li> <li>Experience with the GitLab product as a user or contributor.</li> <li style="line-height: 1.5;">Experience working on a remote, globally distributed team.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>We're part of GitLab's AI Engineering organization and own the AI-powered chat experience embedded across the GitLab platform. Chat Engine is the backend-focused team within the Duo Chat group. We're backend, frontend, and AI specialists working asynchronously across time zones, using issues, merge requests, and documentation as our main collaboration tools. We focus on expanding generative and agentic AI capabilities, improving the performance and reliability of chat workflows, and strengthening the debugging and testing foundations that help us run AI features safely at scale.</p> <div>&nbsp;</div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the&nbsp;United States only. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. title: Toggl: Senior Full Stack
description: Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is  €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world  as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.   The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.   About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of  JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS  - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does.  Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.   The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself.  Our values  fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger:  Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.   Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our own engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Agents generate code and tests in seconds, so speed is no longer the constraint. Confidence is. Agents can produce a passing test suite for software that doesn't work as intended, and a reviewer may not be able to tell the difference without redoing the work by hand.</p> <p>As Engineering Manager, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll build and lead the team that closes this gap. You'll help define what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy. You'll point the team at the right version of an open problem and earn adoption across GitLab by building the best path, not by mandating a process.</p> <ul> <li value="1">Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy.</li> <li value="2">Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions.</li> <li value="3">Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language.</li> <li value="4">Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, with findings fed directly back into the platform.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Build and grow the team by hiring and developing engineers who practice agentic development, and create a culture that treats this as an open problem to solve rather than a process to enforce.</li> <li value="2">Set direction in an undefined space by partnering with your team to shape the technical approach for validating agent-built software.</li> <li value="3">Keep the team focused on the highest-impact version of the problem rather than the easiest one.</li> <li value="4">Earn adoption by building relationships with engineering teams across GitLab, learning how they work with agents today, and creating a platform they choose because it makes them faster and more confident.</li> <li value="5">Measure engineer adoption and trust through real usage, treat adopters as design partners, and use findings to prioritize where confidence is breaking down.</li> <li value="6">Stay close to the technical work by engaging in architecture and design discussions, reviewing proposals, and keeping your judgment current as agentic development changes.</li> <li value="7">Run the team with clear goals, direct feedback, honest performance management, and ownership of complex work from planning through completion without relying on a dedicated program manager.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Direct experience using AI agents to build software, including lessons from successes and missteps and a clear point of view on why a passing test suite isn't the same as working software.</li> <li value="2">Experience leading engineering teams through ambiguous, early-stage problems where the right approach wasn't yet known.</li> <li value="3">The ability to drive adoption through influence and a useful product rather than through mandate, including partnering across teams you don't manage.</li> <li value="4">Technical depth to engage credibly in architecture and validation strategy discussions and earn the trust of senior engineers.</li> <li value="5">Experience designing distributed systems designed to run on Kubernetes first.</li> <li value="5">A history of building accountable, high-performing teams, including hiring well, developing team members, and addressing underperformance directly.</li> <li value="6">Strong written communication skills in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="7">Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency.</li> </ul> <p>This isn't a quality assurance (QA) or test automation management role. We care far more about your experience leading teams that build with agents than about depth in any particular testing discipline.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.</p> <p><strong><em>Poland base salary range:</em></strong><em>&nbsp;<strong>296,000 PLN – 444,000 PLN</strong></em><br><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location and having regard to any applicable collective agreements. The base salary range does not include bonuses, equity, or benefits.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Dubai, UAE<br></strong></h3> <hr> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil, so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption &amp; Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.&nbsp; Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability &amp; Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration &amp; Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education &amp; Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluency in English and Turkish and/or Arabic (written and spoken).</li> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal levelling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative &amp; Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms.&nbsp;</li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.&nbsp; More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. &nbsp;We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. &nbsp;All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. &nbsp;Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. &nbsp;If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Legion: Director of Production Engineering
description: Headquarters: Remote, United States Director of Production Engineering  Remote, United States About this Position Are you passionate about building the reliability, automation, and security foundations that let engineering teams move fast with confidence? At Legion, we are seeking a Director of Engineering, DevOps & SRE to lead the teams responsible for the availability, scalability, and security of our production environment. Our production infrastructure runs on AWS, leveraging services such as EKS, RDS, and a broad set of AWS-native technologies. You will partner closely with engineering and IT to build resilient systems, drive operational excellence, and ensure our platform meets the highest standards of security and compliance. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll spend ~20-30% of your time contributing directly to architecture, tooling, and incident response, and the rest driving vision, roadmap, and cross-team execution. Responsibilities Hire and build a globally-distributed DevOps/SRE engineering team. Recruit, mentor, and manage engineers, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Own the reliability and infrastructure roadmap for our AWS-based production environment, including EKS, RDS, and related AWS services, ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency. Lead the organization's security operations (SecOps) practice, including vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation, to proactively identify and resolve security issues before they impact customers. Define and drive engineering OKRs for infrastructure reliability, automation, and security, and track progress against measurable outcomes. Champion observability and alerting best practices (e.g., Datadog), including automating alert triage and response to reduce mean-time-to-resolution. Solid understanding of agentic AI infrastructure and how AI agentic workflows apply to SDLC and DevOps processes (e.g., automated investigation, remediation, and PR-generation pipelines). Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automation practices to increase engineering velocity and reduce operational toil. Work closely with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure standards, access controls, tooling, and compliance requirements across the organization. Ensure the platform meets the highest standards of security, compliance, and data protection; implement and maintain robust security controls and audit-readiness. Lead and participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation, working with SRE and development teams to meet and exceed availability goals. Stay current on cloud, DevOps, and security best practices, and provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the broader engineering organization. Required Qualifications 8-12 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or production infrastructure roles, including people management experience. Deep hands-on experience running production workloads on AWS, including EKS (Kubernetes), RDS, and other core AWS services (e.g., VPC, IAM, Lambda, S3). Demonstrated experience running security operations (SecOps) — vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation of production security issues. 5+ years of experience leveraging observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) to drive reliability, performance, and alerting improvements. Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD automation. Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or Bash, with day-to-day use of Git and test automation pipelines. Hands-on experience operating Linux/Unix production platforms (Amazon Linux, Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS). Proven track record partnering cross-functionally with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure, tooling, and security standards. Demonstrated experience leading incident management and on-call practices for high-availability production systems. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; Master's degree preferred. Preferred Qualifications Experience with major cloud providers beyond AWS, such as Google Cloud Platform or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, CKS). Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA. 3+ years of experience with Kubernetes or other containerization/orchestration platforms at scale. Experience with Kubernetes-native delivery tooling, including Argo Workflows and Helm. 5+ years of experience leading teams in an agile/scrum environment. Experience building or scaling automated investigation and remediation pipelines for production error classes. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary Range: Base Salary Range  $220,000 - $265,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.  Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living.
